whenToUse: Giving a starting point to people who haven't decided what to look for.
Interests change quickly, as with seasons or events.
whenNotToUse: You can't state the counting period or criteria.
Search volume is too low for the ranking to mean anything.
You'd mix ads in as popular queries (disguised ads).

alternatives.name: Disguised Ads
alternatives.reason: Seeing the problem with dressing ads up as popular items.

accessibility: The ranking is an ol list, so the position is read along with it.
The ▲▼ marks are aria-hidden, and words such as up and down are read separately.
The counting basis is always visible as text beside the heading.
